main_text.p: illud volunt; Sic quoque animam & corpus subsistere sine cibo & potu ait Rabbi Joseph Albo Fundamentorum fol.145: Tunc unaquaque subsistere corpus & animam sine cibo & potu; Ita beatorum gloriam dicunt, solum consistere in beatifica Dei visione, teste Rabbi Leone Mutinensi in Opusculo de Ceremoniis Judæorum, Part.v.cap.10: Dari itaque Paradisum nostri credunt, quem vocant פרדס Hortum deliciarum, ubi beati fruuntur gloria; solum in beatifica Dei visione consistente.
main_text.head: IX.
main_text.p: Qui Affirmantium suscipiunt partes, defendentes fideles post resurrectionem esuros, bibituros, & corporeis fruituros voluptatibus, non tantum varia producunt argumenta ex Sacra Scriptura, verum ex ipsa quoque ratione, imo Veterum Sapientum non omittunt authoritatem, uti liquet ex Rabbi Menasseh Ben Israel, libr.III.de Resurrectione mortuorum, cap.9.pag.320: Ex eo quod hactenus constituimus de novo mundo, videlicet eum plane ejusdem futurum perfectionis atque excellentiæ cum primo mundo, in quo Adamus fuit, antequam peccaverat, consequitur, eos qui in isto mundo resuscitabuntur, iisdem animalibus ac naturalibus actionibus vacaturos & operam daturos esse, Hinc varios opinionis laudat Patronos, Saadiam Gaonem,

page.notes: Catchword and signature: "Uu 2" appears as signature at foot ("Uu 2"); the word "nem," at the end of the last line is the catchword. Hebrew "פרדס" transcribed as printed; some Hebrew letters in the printed text are partly illegible in the scan and are copied as seen. The "Uu 2" signature is at the foot of the page.
